brief: Prioritise Rushmere Junction 230/34kV (SUB-SGW-732) for pre-event attention because units of advanced age with high loading histories have reduced margins against mechanical failure under thermal stress [MG-023]. If this ageing unit cannot be attended before the heat event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. Where a vegetation or obstruction defect is outstanding on the unit, clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity to ensure adequate airflow [SOP-011].
